sentences.en: The records of our discussions are kept by the secretary.
sentences.zh: 我们的会议记录由秘书保管。

sentences.en: This is the place where she works as a secretary.
sentences.zh: 这里是她作为秘书工作的地方。

sentences.en: My secretary has a good command of the English language.
sentences.zh: 我的秘书英语水平很好。

senses.zh: 秘书 - 书记 - 部长, 大臣 形容词: secretarial
